description: This file contains functions and variable definitions related to platform-specific image checking, upgrading, and configuration copying for OpenWrt on MVEBU Cortex-A53 hardware. It includes case statements to handle different board names and invoke appropriate functions for each.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image for specific boards, delegating to legacy checks for recognized board names.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs platform-specific upgrade procedures based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data tailored for specific board types.
